releases.titel: UniFi Access Point (all U7 and E7 models) 8.7.11

Overview: This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:
U7-Pro - July 27, 2026
U7-Lite, U7-In-Wall, U7-Mesh - August 26, 2026
U7-Pro-Max, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Outdoor, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - August 31, 2026
UDB-Switch, AirWire - August 31, 2026
Roaming Improvements

Smoother, more reliable WiFi roaming with improved transitions between access points. Access points can now discover and advertise neighboring APs that aren’t directly within wireless range, improving roaming performance in sparsely populated deployments, alongside other roaming reliability enhancements.
Force WiFi 4 Mode
Wireless networks can now be configured to operate in WiFi 4 mode, improving compatibility with legacy WiFi clients that may experience connectivity or interoperability issues with newer standards.
For the best balance of performance and legacy device support, we recommend using a dedicated WiFi broadcast for legacy clients.
Extended VLAN support on U7 In-Wall

U7 In-Wall Ethernet ports now support VLANs across the full 802.1Q range, enabling deployments that require a significantly larger number of isolated networks. This improves flexibility for large-scale and high-density environments with advanced network segmentation requirements.
Improvements: Improved client roaming behavior.
Improved compatibility with legacy WiFi devices when IoT mode is enabled.
Extended the maximum supported VLAN count to the full 802.1Q range for U7 In-Wall.
Improved handling of configuration changes to reduce wireless client disruption.
Improved Ethernet link speed negotiation with switch ports configured at a fixed speed.
Improved captive portal security with stronger encryption and automatic certificate renewal.
Added Restricted Target Wake Time support on WiFi 7 access points.
Added RADIUS Accounting Stop packets on reboot and firmware upgrade.
Improved boot speed on access points with many WiFi networks configured.
Improved Locate mode LED brightness.
Bugfixes: Fixed clients on VLAN SSIDs occasionally receiving traffic from the Default network.
Fixed connectivity issues affecting legacy and IoT devices on 5 GHz WiFi 7 access points.
Fixed connectivity issues affecting some WiFi 7 clients when Multi-Link Operation was enabled.
Fixed severe 5 GHz WiFi performance degradation after automatic off-channel scans.
Fixed Multicast and Broadcast filtering blocking traffic for hosts added to the exceptions list.
Fixed Minimum RSSI preventing mesh access points from establishing wireless uplinks.
Fixed slow mesh recovery and repeated restarts when falling back from a wireless to a wired uplink.
Fixed several mesh access point reliability issues.
Fixed 6 GHz radios ignoring configured reduced transmit power after AFC responses.
Fixed 6 GHz transmit power dropping unexpectedly.
Fixed WiFi speed limit rules occasionally not being applied.
Fixed several Auto Channel Selection issues.
Fixed NTP time synchronization getting stuck on an unreachable first server.
Fixed legitimate same-network access points being flagged as rogue APs.
Fixed per-client traffic statistics and usage graphs showing zero on WiFi 7 access points.
Fixed ghost clients appearing in the Network application after failed authentication.
Fixed duplicate wired clients appearing for devices using wireless mesh uplinks with multiple VLANs.
Fixed neighboring access point information not updating after adding a new WiFi network.
Fixed SNMP reporting issues on WiFi 7 access points.
Fixed the access point LED not reflecting the correct state after configuration changes.
Fixed disabling E7 LEDs also suppressing boot and firmware upgrade indicators.
Additional information: INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:
UniFi Console Support File (as private attachment)

Overview: This release introduces Multi-Link Operation (MLO) Mesh support, specifically optimized for AirWire and UDB-Switch deployments. By leveraging MLO STR (Simultaneous Transmit and Receive), the mesh backhaul can now utilize multiple wireless bands simultaneously, improving throughput, latency, and link stability.
To configure Mesh MLO STR UniFi Network 10.2+ required
Mesh MLO operates on 5 GHz + 6 GHz bands
Child devices with mesh MLO support: AirWire and UDB-Switch
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:
U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Outdoor, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - April 13, 2026
U7-Pro-Max, U7-In-Wall, U7-Lite, U7-Mesh - April 17, 2026
U7-Pro - April 21, 2026
Improvements: Improved client connectivity and roam events reporting.
Improved automatic channel selection for 160 MHz bandwidth.
Improved boot time.
Stability improvements.
Bugfixes: Fixed authentication failures for Samsung A53 devices.
Fixed SSIDs not broadcasting due to boot or configuration race conditions.
Fixed IGMP/MLD querier being enabled.
Fixed LED brightness control on U7 series devices.
Fixed MLO peer inactivity and bulk roaming stability issues.
Fixed multicast/broadcast blocker incorrectly dropping ARP requests.
Fixed RADIUS CoA re-authentication timeouts.
Fixed ARP proxy stopping after more than 30 IPv6-capable clients connected.
Additional information: INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.

If you encounter any issues, please share setup details and a support file. When possible, generate it before downgrading or power cycling, with Debug logs enabled. A support file from a working state is also helpful for comparison.
